description: Create the minimal Living 3D Graph Python package, confirm Robot Framework is importable, and add tiny static fixtures for later parser tests.
scope: Maintain pyproject.toml with package metadata and pytest configuration
Maintain src/living_graph/__init__.py with a version string
Maintain tests/test_package.py package import smoke test
Add tiny fixtures under tests/fixtures for Robot and Python parser tasks
acceptanceCriteria: The project can run pytest successfully, import living_graph.__version__, import robot.api.TestSuiteBuilder, and provide tiny static fixtures for future parser tests.
constraints: Do not implement graph extraction logic in this task.
Do not add frontend rendering code in this task.

subtasks.title: Confirm package skeleton imports
subtasks.summary: Skeleton only. Ensure the Living Graph package exposes __version__ and tests can import it. No parser logic.
scope: Keep tests/test_package.py focused on the package import smoke test
instructions: Write or run the package import smoke test first.
Do not implement any parser, graph, watcher, or renderer code.

subtasks.title: Confirm Robot Framework API import
subtasks.summary: Dependency smoke test only. Confirm robot.api.TestSuiteBuilder is importable. No parser logic.
instructions: Write the failing dependency smoke test before touching implementation files.

subtasks.title: Add tiny parser fixtures
subtasks.summary: Fixture data only. Add small .robot, .resource, and .py files under tests/fixtures for later extractor tasks.
scope: Create tests/fixtures/simple_test.robot with one test case calling two keywords
Create tests/fixtures/simple_keywords.resource with one keyword calling another keyword
Create tests/fixtures/simple_library.py with one function calling another function
Add tests/test_fixtures_exist.py to assert fixture files exist and contain expected names
instructions: Do not implement parser behavior in this subtask.

businessRules: Keep the package importable with a stable version string.
Use Robot Framework 7.x parser APIs in later tasks, confirmed here by a smoke import only.
Fixtures should stay 2-5 meaningful lines per file where practical.
